decisions.reason: Because this core-adjacent product remained offered after other 2018 launches were culled, and the firm has growth, hiring, R&D capability, and portfolio slack, its performance likely meets or is close enough to aspiration to justify retention.

As a technically upgraded tube product closely tied to the firm's engineering base, it likely compares favorably with aspiration levels and is easier to sustain within a growing, innovation-oriented firm with available slack.
